tracks_analyzed.title: Stage One (Pariah Remix)
tracks_analyzed.epistemic_interpretation: Long-form progressive trance - high know (developed ideas), moderate dynamics, good coherence. The track builds slowly with clear structure.

tracks_analyzed.title: My Lexicon (Original Mix)
tracks_analyzed.epistemic_interpretation: Classic progressive house - high clarity, good coherence, slightly louder/more impactful than Stage One. Lower uncertainty suggests more 'certain' musical direction.

findings: BPM detection via silence detection unreliable for electronic music - needs proper onset/beat detection (aubio/librosa)
Loudness metrics (mean volume, integrated loudness, dynamic range) extract correctly
Duration-based 'know' mapping works well for long-form electronic tracks
Dynamic range maps well to 'change' vector
These late 90s/early 2000s progressive tracks share similar epistemic signatures: high know, moderate clarity/coherence, controlled dynamics
